In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> a '''hideout''' of the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] [[Golden Storm]] was located within the [[Ten Thousand Grains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was used to hold their [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="EO" />
